tool_limitations.limitation: Blank-window (Section 9) check only detects <Window.SystemBackdrop>/MicaBackdrop/DesktopAcrylicBackdrop; it does not detect the other composition-dependent transparent-window trigger the current scaffold emits (ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true + <TitleBar>).
tool_limitations.suggested_tweak: Extend Section 9 to also WARN when a MainWindow sets ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true / uses the scaffold <TitleBar> control without reverting to an opaque standard title bar.

doc_errors.where: SKILL.md 'Blank window even though the visual tree is fully populated (scaffold system backdrop)' + MIGRATION-PATTERNS.md#system-backdrop-blank
doc_errors.wrong: States that deleting the <Window.SystemBackdrop> block 'both restores reliable rendering and matches the opaque original' — implying that is the complete fix.
doc_errors.correct: Removing the backdrop is necessary but NOT sufficient on the current scaffold: ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true + the <TitleBar> control keep the window transparent/composition-dependent and it still blanks in headless/VM capture. The window must also be made opaque (revert to the standard title bar or give the Window root an opaque Background).

special_apis.special_handling: Scaffold-only chrome (not from the UWP source). Puts the window into a DWM-composition-dependent transparent mode that renders blank in headless/VM/RDP/automated-capture sessions. For faithful UWP parity, revert to the default opaque system title bar.

errors_encountered.error: Migrated WinUI 3 window renders fully blank white for all 7 scenarios despite a fully populated UIA tree and responsive controls.
errors_encountered.root_cause: Current 'dotnet new winui' scaffold makes the window composition-dependent in TWO ways: <Window.SystemBackdrop><MicaBackdrop/> AND ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true (+ the <TitleBar> control). The agent removed the backdrop (per skill) but left ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true, so the window stayed transparent and DWM composition (absent in the capture VM) never presented it.
errors_encountered.fix: Also neutralize the extend-into-title-bar path: remove the scaffold <TitleBar> block, drop ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true / SetTitleBar(...) in MainWindow.xaml.cs, and let the window use its standard opaque title bar (matches the UWP original).

dev_agent_struggles.symptom: Agent declared done with a clean build + validator PASS, but every scenario renders blank white.
dev_agent_struggles.turns_or_retries: n/a (no visual feedback available to the migration agent)
dev_agent_struggles.root_cause: Skill guidance told the agent that removing <Window.SystemBackdrop> is the blank-window fix; it followed that and had no signal that ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar=true is a second, equally-fatal composition-dependent trigger.
dev_agent_struggles.preventable_by: Broadening the blank-window guidance + validator check to cover ExtendsContentIntoTitleBar/<TitleBar>, not just the backdrop.

env_issues.issue: Parity screenshots are captured in a headless/VM session with no live DWM composition of transparent/backdrop window surfaces.
env_issues.workaround: Migrate to a plain opaque window (no system backdrop, standard opaque title bar) so rendering does not depend on DWM composition.
